track.title: A Measure of Elsewhere
track.purpose: Keep the D, F, A and E harmony while the bass order and upper stereo position change.
track.hypothesis: Harmonic persistence can support a stable identity while the upper bass and atmosphere move.
track.invariant: Every chord voicing contains pitch classes D, F, A and E. The low bass and kick stay centered.

foxdot.import_method: Installed Patterns and TimeVar definitions in isolated package namespaces. Package realtime startup was not executed.
foxdot.role: Compose new finite note, rhythm, and phrase transformations for the original tempo studies.

tail_policy: Exact full duration includes a three-second fade and tail. This is not a seamless loop.
clock: Finite offline score. Gameplay does not use this clock.
